description: Purchase a content license from the Opedd protocol using a Stripe payment method. Returns a license key (format: OP-XXXX-XXXX) and a certificate URL. The buyer receives a Handshake Email with their license key. Set OPEDD_BUYER_EMAIL and OPEDD_PAYMENT_METHOD_ID env vars to avoid passing them on every call. Single-article purchases are Human republication licences only (license_type 'human'). AI licences (AI answers, AI training, client display) are bought as licence orders: see place_licence_order.

article_id.description: Opedd article UUID (use this OR article_url)

article_url.description: URL of the article to license (use this OR article_id)

buyer_email.description: Email address for the license. Falls back to OPEDD_BUYER_EMAIL env var.

buyer_name.description: Full name of the buyer (for the license record and certificate)

buyer_organization.description: Organization or company name (for enterprise/editorial licenses)

intended_use.description: Intended use of the licensed content

license_type.description: human = Human republication (editorial republication of one article)

payment_method_id.description: Stripe payment method ID (pm_...). Falls back to OPEDD_PAYMENT_METHOD_ID env var.

terms_accepted.description: REQUIRED. Set true only after the buyer (your principal) has accepted the Opedd licence terms at opedd.com/terms. The acceptance timestamp is recorded with the licence; purchases without genuine acceptance are rejected.

name: purchase_license
